findings: Published-root discovery-execute reconciles an explicit binding to published cohort hashes before load. Session recovery no longer copies discovery_candidate_scope onto every hypothesis. A full-content HARD_CLOSE missing evidence_surface_mode raises UNKNOWN_PRIOR_SCOPE; PriorScopeTransportTests covers that path.

OrdinaryOwnerPathTests seals and imports a corpus, runs discovery-binding with values_loaded false, runs discovery-execute without --binding, then persist-draft, freeze, fixture critic, finalize, and show-session SYNTHESIS_COMPLETE. Protected, unknown-role, and hash failures are asserted before load_parquet_rows.

holdout=false is derived only after REQUIRED_LABELS match and no protected holdout. A contradictory binding on a published root is replaced by the published pairs or rejected. Near-complete valid closes do not become a free pass. Scope recovery is per candidate_id, not a broadcast of one session scope.

Skill, slash command, and operator recipe name discovery-binding, state that it does not load parquet values, list the pre-loader stop codes, and set both --data-root and --store to the canonical data root. A cold agent does not hand-write holdout=false.
